items.title: Conormal algebras of the fibres induced by a formal local map are controlled by one finite type modification
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms)

items.difficulty_reason: This is the graded companion of the Artin approximation control step. Over a composable pair Y -> T -> S of finite type Noetherian schemes and a local O_{S,s}-algebra map sigma : O_{T,t} -> O_{S,s}^, the lemma produces a single finite type modification (T',t') -> (T,t) through which sigma factors, such that every other sigma' factoring through it induces closed immersions Y_sigma <- Y_t -> Y_sigma' with isomorphic conormal algebras. The proof has to compare two base changes of Y along two different formal maps that agree through the modification, then transport the conormal algebra across the comparison; the uniformity in sigma' is what carries the content, since a single modification must serve all competitors at once. The graded statement is not implied by the ungraded control lemma in any routine way, because conormal algebras of the two closed immersions, not just the maps, must match. Retained author proof at lines 11592-11718.
